new.md:
Creates a new `GtkMenuButton` widget with downwards-pointing
arrow as the only child.

You can replace the child widget with another `GtkWidget`
should you wish to.

doc.md:
Displays a popup when clicked.

This popup can be provided either as a `GtkPopover` or as an abstract
`GMenuModel`.

The `GtkMenuButton` widget can show either an icon (set with the
[`MenuButton:icon-name`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:icon-name) property) or a label (set with the
[`MenuButton:label`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:label) property). If neither is explicitly set,
a [`Image`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Image) is automatically created, using an arrow image oriented
according to [`MenuButton:direction`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:direction) or the generic
“open-menu-symbolic” icon if the direction is not set.

The positioning of the popup is determined by the
[`MenuButton:direction`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:direction) property of the menu button.

For menus, the [`Widget:halign`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#property:halign) and [`Widget:valign`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#property:valign)
properties of the menu are also taken into account. For example, when the
direction is %GTK_ARROW_DOWN and the horizontal alignment is %GTK_ALIGN_START,
the menu will be positioned below the button, with the starting edge
(depending on the text direction) of the menu aligned with the starting
edge of the button. If there is not enough space below the button, the
menu is popped up above the button instead. If the alignment would move
part of the menu offscreen, it is “pushed in”.

|           | start                | center                | end                |
| -         | ---                  | ---                   | ---                |
| **down**  | ![](down-start.png)  | ![](down-center.png)  | ![](down-end.png)  |
| **up**    | ![](up-start.png)    | ![](up-center.png)    | ![](up-end.png)    |
| **left**  | ![](left-start.png)  | ![](left-center.png)  | ![](left-end.png)  |
| **right** | ![](right-start.png) | ![](right-center.png) | ![](right-end.png) |

# CSS nodes

```
menubutton
╰── button.toggle
    ╰── <content>
         ╰── [arrow]
```

`GtkMenuButton` has a single CSS node with name `menubutton`
which contains a `button` node with a `.toggle` style class.

If the button contains an icon, it will have the `.image-button` style class,
if it contains text, it will have `.text-button` style class. If an arrow is
visible in addition to an icon, text or a custom child, it will also have
`.arrow-button` style class.

Inside the toggle button content, there is an `arrow` node for
the indicator, which will carry one of the `.none`, `.up`, `.down`,
`.left` or `.right` style classes to indicate the direction that
the menu will appear in. The CSS is expected to provide a suitable
image for each of these cases using the `-gtk-icon-source` property.

Optionally, the `menubutton` node can carry the `.circular` style class
to request a round appearance.

# Accessibility

`GtkMenuButton` uses the [`AccessibleRole.button`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:button) role.

set_active.brief: Sets whether the menu button is active.
set_active.md: Sets whether the menu button is active.

set_always_show_arrow.brief: Sets whether to show a dropdown arrow even when using an icon or a custom child.
set_always_show_arrow.md:
Sets whether to show a dropdown arrow even when using an icon or a custom
child.

set_can_shrink.brief: Sets whether the button size can be smaller than the natural size of its contents.
set_can_shrink.md:
Sets whether the button size can be smaller than the natural size of
its contents.

For text buttons, setting `can_shrink` to true will ellipsize the label.

For icon buttons, this function has no effect.

set_child.md:
Sets the child widget of `menu_button`.

Setting a child resets [`MenuButton:label`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:label) and
[`MenuButton:icon-name`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:icon-name).

If [`MenuButton:always-show-arrow`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:always-show-arrow) is set to `TRUE` and
[`MenuButton:direction`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:direction) is not `GTK_ARROW_NONE`, a dropdown arrow
will be shown next to the child.

set_create_popup_func.brief: Sets `func` to be called when a popup is about to be shown.
set_create_popup_func.md:
Sets `func` to be called when a popup is about to be shown.

`func` should use one of

 - [`MenuButton.set_popover()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#method:set_popover)
 - [`MenuButton.set_menu_model()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#method:set_menu_model)

to set a popup for `menu_button`.
If `func` is non-`NULL`, `menu_button` will always be sensitive.

Using this function will not reset the menu widget attached to
`menu_button`. Instead, this can be done manually in `func`.

set_direction.brief: Sets the direction in which the popup will be popped up.
set_direction.md:
Sets the direction in which the popup will be popped up.

If the button is automatically populated with an arrow icon,
its direction will be changed to match.

If the does not fit in the available space in the given direction,
GTK will its best to keep it inside the screen and fully visible.

If you pass %GTK_ARROW_NONE for a `direction`, the popup will behave
as if you passed %GTK_ARROW_DOWN (although you won’t see any arrows).

set_has_frame.brief: Sets the style of the button.
set_has_frame.md: Sets the style of the button.

set_icon_name.brief: Sets the name of an icon to show inside the menu button.
set_icon_name.md:
Sets the name of an icon to show inside the menu button.

Setting icon name resets [`MenuButton:label`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:label) and
[`MenuButton:child`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:child).

If [`MenuButton:always-show-arrow`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:always-show-arrow) is set to `TRUE` and
[`MenuButton:direction`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:direction) is not `GTK_ARROW_NONE`, a dropdown arrow
will be shown next to the icon.

set_label.brief: Sets the label to show inside the menu button.
set_label.md:
Sets the label to show inside the menu button.

Setting a label resets [`MenuButton:icon-name`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:icon-name) and
[`MenuButton:child`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:child).

If [`MenuButton:direction`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:direction) is not `GTK_ARROW_NONE`, a dropdown
arrow will be shown next to the label.

set_menu_model.brief: Sets the `GMenuModel` from which the popup will be constructed.
set_menu_model.md:
Sets the `GMenuModel` from which the popup will be constructed.

If `menu_model` is `NULL`, the button is disabled.

A [`Popover`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Popover) will be created from the menu model with
[`PopoverMenu.new_from_model()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PopoverMenu#constructor:new_from_model). Actions will be connected
as documented for this function.

If [`MenuButton:popover`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:popover) is already set, it will be
dissociated from the `menu_button`, and the property is set to `NULL`.

set_popover.brief: Sets the `GtkPopover` that will be popped up when the `menu_button` is clicked.
set_popover.md:
Sets the `GtkPopover` that will be popped up when the `menu_button` is clicked.

If `popover` is `NULL`, the button is disabled.

If [`MenuButton:menu-model`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MenuButton#property:menu-model) is set, the menu model is dissociated
from the `menu_button`, and the property is set to `NULL`.

set_primary.brief: Sets whether menu button acts as a primary menu.
set_primary.md:
Sets whether menu button acts as a primary menu.

Primary menus can be opened with the <kbd>F10</kbd> key.

Emitted to when the menu button is activated.

The `::activate` signal on `GtkMenuButton` is an action signal and
emitting it causes the button to pop up its menu.
